Classic Fiction.author: George Orwell
Classic Fiction.description: A dystopian social science fiction novel and cautionary tale. The story follows the life of Winston Smith, a low-ranking member of 'the Party'.
Classic Fiction.authorBio: George Orwell (Eric Arthur Blair) was an English novelist and critic known for his opposition to totalitarianism.
Classic Fiction.introWhy: Orwell wrote the book to warn Western nations of the dangers of totalitarian regimes and expansionist surveillance states.
Classic Fiction.introHow: He composed the manuscript on the isolated Scottish island of Jura while battling severe tuberculosis and physically writing long hours.
Classic Fiction.introWhat: A chilling dystopian projection of a world ruled by constant surveillance, cognitive doublethink, and total party control.

Classic Fiction.title: Pride and Prejudice
Classic Fiction.author: Jane Austen
Classic Fiction.description: A romantic novel of manners that charts the emotional development of the protagonist Elizabeth Bennet.

Classic Fiction.title: Frankenstein
Classic Fiction.author: Mary Shelley
Classic Fiction.description: The story of Victor Frankenstein, a young scientist who creates a sapient creature in an unorthodox scientific experiment.

Fantasy & Sci-Fi.title: Dune
Fantasy & Sci-Fi.author: Frank Herbert
Fantasy & Sci-Fi.description: Set on the desert planet Arrakis, Dune is the story of the boy Paul Atreides, heir to a noble family tasked with ruling an inhospitable world.

Fantasy & Sci-Fi.description: The classic fantasy trilogy following the quest to destroy the One Ring.

Fantasy & Sci-Fi.title: The Hobbit
Fantasy & Sci-Fi.author: J.R.R. Tolkien
Fantasy & Sci-Fi.description: A great modern classic and the prelude to The Lord of the Rings. Bilbo Baggins is a hobbit who enjoys a comfortable, unambitious life.

US History.title: Who Built America? Working People and the Nation's History
US History.author: American Social History Project
US History.description: A comprehensive textbook exploring the history of the United States through the lives, struggles, and contributions of working people.

US History.title: The American Yawp

US History.description: A free, collaboratively built, open-source U.S. history textbook presenting a diverse and integrated narrative of the American past.

US History.title: The Federalist Papers
US History.author: Hamilton, Madison, & Jay
US History.description: A collection of 85 articles and essays written by Alexander Hamilton, James Madison, and John Jay under the collective pseudonym 'Publius' to promote the ratification of the United States Constitution.

US History.title: United States Constitution
US History.author: 13 Signers
US History.description: 'The United States Constitution' by United States is a foundational document drafted in 1787 and operational since 1789. Born from the failures of the Articles of Confederation, it establishes the supreme law of America through seven original articles defining federal government structure.
